purpose: Candidate upstream selections with immutable identifiers for F-01.2 to lock and verify. Not a lockfile, not an install record, not evidence of runtime compatibility.

verification.pass: identifier observed from the upstream primary source and cross-checked against at least one independent upstream record (see per-check evidence)
verification.fail: identifier could not be obtained or two upstream records disagree
verification.unknown: no upstream record exists to establish it, or establishing it requires installing/running (F-01.2)
verification.not_run: check deliberately not performed in F-01.1 (e.g. cryptographic signature verification)

coupling_verdict.compatible: upstream primary source explicitly declares this pairing at these exact versions (metadata/source only; never runtime-tested here)
coupling_verdict.incompatible: an upstream declared constraint excludes the pairing
coupling_verdict.unknown: no upstream declaration, or only provable by installing and running

notes_for_F-01.2: Pin all four OpenHands Python packages (openhands-sdk, openhands-tools, openhands-workspace, openhands-agent-server) to 1.60.1 explicitly with hashes; their PyPI metadata does not constrain each other.

Override the Agent Server per-conversation image (config conversation_image / OH_CONVERSATION_IMAGE) with the pinned digest ghcr.io/openhands/agent-server@sha256:b43ee580c2177280c81cb807c9a559d7a14aa13b48dba5040132a6a637bb6d55; the upstream default is the floating latest-python tag.

Pin OCI images by index digest (multi-arch), not by tag. ghcr.io/openhands/agent-server:e99e5c7-python resolves to a different index (sha256:8857fbd2cae6798678f208f18a85d23dc2730a3df8ecdf074373624b69ce675f) than 1.60.1-python for the same commit; use the 1.60.1-python digest, which carries tag provenance and is the Canvas image's base.
OCI index entries with platform unknown/unknown are BuildKit attestation manifests (SLSA provenance; Canvas also has a Syft SBOM scanner in its provenance) - usable as SBOM/provenance input.
npm: lock by dist.integrity (sha512). Backlog.md resolves a platform package (backlog.md-linux-x64 / -arm64) via optionalDependencies; lock those too.
PyPI SDK wheels have no PEP 740 provenance; wheel-to-commit linkage is unknown unless F-01.2 rebuilds from e99e5c7 and compares.

Licence inputs for Grant: SDK packages have no PyPI licence metadata; Backlog.md platform packages have no licence field; agent-server image bundles third-party ACP CLIs (claude-code, codex, gemini-cli); assistant-ui depends on assistant-cloud.
Agent Canvas image and launcher embed PostHog telemetry configuration; egress/telemetry policy is a qualification item.
No signature (Sigstore/Cosign/GPG) was verified in F-01.1; npm provenance payloads and BuildKit provenance were decoded, not cryptographically verified.

Freshness: openhands v1.60.1 and Canvas v1.36.0 were published on 2026-11-05 (<1 day before retrieval). The previous coherent upstream set is Canvas v1.35.0 (agentServer 1.59.0, typescript-client 1.59.0, automation 1.26.1, floor 1.59.0); its identifiers were not resolved here.
